planning_assumptions: The About page should be accessible from the authenticated (post-login) view, since the app gates all content behind login.
No React Router is installed; the app uses state-based routing with window.history.pushState — the About page will follow the same pattern using a 'page' state variable in the authenticated section.
The Penpot design file was not accessible, so styling will use the existing CSS custom properties (--app-bg, --app-text, etc.) defined in App.css to stay consistent with the design system.
Navigation between Calculator and About will be done with simple text links/buttons consistent with the existing button component style.
Previous session tasks were marked done but no files were committed — treating this as a fresh implementation.

tasks.title: Create About page component and integrate into app navigation
tasks.description:
1. WHAT: Create a new About page that shows a heading 'About' and a short descriptive paragraph about the calculator app, accessible from the authenticated (post-login) view via navigation links. 2. READ FIRST: Read src/App.tsx (routing pattern and theme context usage), src/App.css (CSS variables and design tokens), src/components/Calculator.tsx and src/components/Calculator.css (component style patterns), src/App.test.tsx (existing test structure for App-level navigation tests). 3. FILES TO CREATE: src/components/About.tsx — named export 'About' component with an

About

heading and a descriptive paragraph. src/components/About.css — styles using CSS variables (--app-bg, --app-text, --button-bg-start, etc.) matching the existing design system from App.css. src/components/About.test.tsx — tests for the About component rendering the heading and paragraph text. 4. FILES TO MODIFY: src/App.tsx — in the authenticated return block, add a 'page' state ('calculator' | 'about'), render About component when page is 'about' and Calculator when 'calculator', add navigation links to switch between the two pages. src/App.test.tsx — add tests verifying the About navigation link appears after login, clicking it shows the About heading, and clicking back to Calculator shows the calculator. 5. APPROACH: Follow the exact same state+pushState pattern already in App.tsx for login/signup view switching. The About component should accept no props and use ThemeContext via useContext if it needs theme-aware classes. CSS should use the same CSS custom properties (--app-bg, --app-text) as the rest of the app for automatic light/dark theme support. Navigation links should use a
element with simple anchor-style buttons (no full page reload). 6. PATTERNS: Follow src/components/Login.tsx for component structure (named export, TypeScript interfaces for props), src/components/Login.css for CSS variable usage, and src/components/Login.test.tsx for test patterns (vi.mock, render, screen queries).
acceptance_criteria: After logging in, a navigation link or button labeled 'About' is visible on the screen
Clicking the 'About' navigation link displays a heading with the text 'About' on the page
The About page shows a paragraph describing the calculator project
A navigation link to return to the Calculator view is visible on the About page, and clicking it brings back the calculator

tasks.title: Run full test suite and type-check the About page implementation
